verdict.rationale: Gide Loyrette Nouel is a law firm offering legal advisory services, not a software product, so user-configurable background automations are a category error for this kind of product. The firm's mention of using AI internally to optimise its own services is not a user-facing automation capability, and the API/llms.txt probes found nothing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
